description: Add key/value rows and get a properly percent-encoded query string for your URLs.

faqs.a: Yes — keys and values are encoded with encodeURIComponent, so spaces, & and unicode are handled.
They are kept in the exact order you entered them.
Rows with an empty key are skipped. An empty value is kept as key= (no value).
faqs.q: What about empty keys or values?

faqs.a: Yes — fill in the optional base URL field and the string is appended to it.
faqs.q: Can I build a full URL?

howto: Add rows and type each parameter key and value.
Click Build — the encoded query string appears below.
title: Query String Builder
